caption: The drawing depicts a single standing figure positioned centrally on a plain, uncolored background with a faint rectangular border. The figure wears a long, layered robe in light beige and golden-brown hues with intricate detailing and some gray shadows for depth. The outer garment features wide sleeves and subtle embroidered patterns. Underneath, a sash or belt in a soft yellow tone is tied around the waist, and beneath the robe, dark gray or black loose trousers are visible. The footwear consists of pointed shoes in a similar dark shade to the trousers. On the figure’s head is a large, wrapped turban in matching beige and ochre tones, adorned with a decorative element at the front, and a netted or veiled section falls over the long, dark hair. The figure holds an object in the left hand close to the chest, while the right arm is extended slightly outward, fingers delicately positioned as if holding or presenting something. The overall composition is vertically oriented with the figure occupying most of the space, and there are no additional objects or background elements present.
title: Cigar Store Figure
